author: yiranwangkk
name: summerlouver
description: Animated WebGL shader background in the Paper Texture style. Default variant. Generated by the 21st.dev Shader Builder. Adapted from Paper Shaders under Apache-2.0. 4-color palette (#FFFFFF, #9FADBC, #D8D4CA, #777168). Features: cursor-reactive (swirl). A drop-in, zero-dependency React component for hero sections and animated gradient/noise backgrounds.
